description: Hamler Community Park is a 13-acre privately owned community park on the edge of Hamler, purchased in 1974 for $21,000 by the Hamler Summerfest non-profit organization. The park hosts the annual Hamler Summerfest German Heritage festival (last weekend of July) and the Hamler Country Fest, and is open as a community park year-round. A 100'x250' steel structure (built 1988) houses basketball and tennis courts for public use.
